import pandas as pd

# File paths for all source tables
source_0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_33/test_0.csv"
source_1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_33/test_1.csv"
source_2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_33/test_2.csv"
source_3_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_33/test_3.csv"
source_4_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_33/test_4.csv"

# Load all source dataframes
df0 = pd.read_csv(source_0_path)  # ['batsman', 'batsman_runs'] (516 rows)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source_1_path)  # ['batsman', 'total_runs'] (516 rows)
df2 = pd.read_csv(source_2_path)  # ['batsman', 'total_runs'] (516 rows)
df3 = pd.read_csv(source_3_path)  # ['batsman', 'batsman_runs'] (516 rows)
df4 = pd.read_csv(source_4_path)  # ['batsman', 'batsman_runs'] (258 rows)

# Step 1: Merge df0 and df1 on 'batsman'
# Rename columns to avoid collision after merge
df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={"batsman_runs": "batsman_runs_x"})
df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={"total_runs": "total_runs_x"})

df_01 = pd.merge(df0_renamed, df1_renamed, on="batsman", how="inner")

# Step 2: Merge df2 and df3 on 'batsman'
df2_renamed = df2.rename(columns={"total_runs": "total_runs_y"})
df3_renamed = df3.rename(columns={"batsman_runs": "batsman_runs_y"})

df_23 = pd.merge(df2_renamed, df3_renamed, on="batsman", how="inner")

# Step 3: Merge df_01 and df_23 on 'batsman'
df_0123 = pd.merge(df_01, df_23, on="batsman", how="inner")

# Step 4: Merge the above with df4 on 'batsman'
# df4 has 'batsman_runs' (float), which corresponds to the last column in target schema
df_final = pd.merge(df_0123, df4, on="batsman", how="inner")

# Step 5: Cast columns to required types according to target schema:
# Target Schema: ['batsman': string, 'batsman_runs_x': float, 'total_runs_x': integer,
#                 'total_runs_y': integer, 'batsman_runs_y': integer, 'batsman_runs': integer]

# 'batsman' is string by default
df_final['batsman_runs_x'] = df_final['batsman_runs_x'].astype(float)
df_final['total_runs_x'] = df_final['total_runs_x'].astype(int)
df_final['total_runs_y'] = df_final['total_runs_y'].astype(int)
df_final['batsman_runs_y'] = df_final['batsman_runs_y'].astype(int)

# The last 'batsman_runs' column from df4 is float, but target expects integer
# We will convert by rounding then to int
df_final['batsman_runs'] = df_final['batsman_runs'].round().astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
df_final = df_final[['batsman', 'batsman_runs_x', 'total_runs_x', 'total_runs_y', 'batsman_runs_y', 'batsman_runs']]

# Write the final dataframe to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_33/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
